title: Tailwind with Next.js
definition: The integration and optimization of Tailwind CSS within the Next.js framework.
simpleExplanation: Next.js and Tailwind are a match made in heaven. When you run `npx create-next-app`, Tailwind is configured automatically. The most important thing to know is that Tailwind works perfectly with Next.js Server Components, shipping zero CSS-in-JS runtime payload to the client.
realWorldExample: Using Tailwind classes directly inside a Next.js App Router layout file (`app/layout.tsx`) to style the global `<body>` tag.

basic: When creating a new Next.js app, do you have to install Tailwind manually?
intermediate: Does Tailwind CSS impact the JavaScript bundle size of a Next.js Server Component?

answers.question: Install manually?
answers.answer: No. The Next.js CLI asks you 'Would you like to use Tailwind CSS?' and sets up the PostCSS configuration, config file, and global CSS automatically.

answers.question: Impact JS bundle?
answers.answer: Zero impact. Tailwind outputs raw, static CSS. Unlike styled-components or Emotion, Tailwind does not require any JavaScript to calculate or inject styles at runtime.
